<Highlight>序列权柄：</>
奇迹、诡秘、愚弄、历史

愚弄命运、时间与历史，在历史迷雾中追溯过往、窥探未来。掌控诡秘变化，游走于灵界深处，于绝境中创造奇迹。是命运的玩笑者，时间的愚弄者，以诡秘之力愚昧现实法则，在不可能中创造可能。

<Highlight> Sequence Authority: </> 
 Miracle, Mystery, Fooling, History 
 
 <Highlight> Core Ability: </> 
 Fools fate, time, and history, tracing the past and peeking into the future within the fog of history. Controls mysterious changes, roams deep within the Spirit World, and creates miracles in desperate situations. It is the joker of fate, the fooler of time, using mysterious power to fool the laws of reality and creating possibilities within the impossible.

source_cn:
让我猜猜……你肯定在想'这些牌到底怎么走'对不对？    
　　放心，就算你不懂扑克，我也不会嘲笑你~
 　　作为一个负责的主持人，我还是准备了这本宝典——《傻瓜都能懂的牌经》！

 　　所谓<Letter_Highlight>顺子</>，就是连续的5个数字，比如：4-5-6-7-8。
 　　明白了吗？必须一个跟一个，不能跳着来！也<Letter_Highlight>不能反悔！</>

 　　花色？在这里，爱情不分种族~红心、黑桃、方块、梅花，混着来都行！
 　　重要的只有<Letter_Highlight>数字顺序</>，记住了吗？

 　　如果你踩错了……嘻嘻，你会摔下去，摔下去，再摔下去！

 　　——爱你的解说员，小丑 敬上
ref_en:
Let me guess... You must be thinking 'how do these cards move', right?    
    Don't worry, even if you don't understand poker, I won't laugh at you~
     As a responsible host, I have prepared this treasure book—《Card Sutra for Dummies》!

     The so-called <Letter_Highlight>Straight</> is 5 consecutive numbers, for example: 4-5-6-7-8.
     Understand? They must follow one after another, no skipping! And <Letter_Highlight>no taking it back!</>

     Suits? Here, love knows no race~ Hearts, Spades, Diamonds, Clubs, mix them all you want!
     The only thing that matters is the <Letter_Highlight>numerical order</>, got it?

     If you step wrong... hee hee, you will fall, fall, and fall again!

     ——Yours truly, the commentator, Clown

source_cn:
1.事件目标：在特定区域参与并完成出现的突发事件，即可获得丰厚奖励。
2.事件类型：事件包含<Highlight>“剧情”、“挑战”、“竞技”</>三种类型。
3.刷新规则：当玩家进入“罪恶廷根”后会直接刷新出所有满足条件的事件，其中<Highlight>“竞技”事件报名时间为两分钟</>，突发事件刷新时间间隔，会取玩家进入场景的时间，<Highlight>“挑战”事件每间隔约10秒钟后会进行刷新</>，如果事件已结束则会再次出现。
4.奖励规则：不同事件类型的奖励规则不同，<Highlight>“剧情”事件成功可领奖，“挑战”事件有不同的分档奖励，“困难·挑战”不设分档奖励，“竞技”事件会根据玩家排名发奖。</>
5.奖励上限：单个玩家每周通过事件获得奖励的次数无上限，但是<Highlight>每周悬赏值有上限</>。
6.失败条件：若在事件时限内未能完成目标（若有），则视为事件失败。
7.脱离判定：若在事件完成前离开事件区域过远，会被判定为放弃事件，无法获得奖励。
8.玩家战力：进入“罪恶廷根”位面会进行属性平衡，玩家在其中的“剧情”、困难·挑战”、“竞技”都为属性平衡玩法，<Highlight>“激战·邦尼”会受玩家战力影响，根据玩家战力转化梯度的属性平衡</>。
ref_en:
1. Event Objective: Participate in and complete the sudden events that appear in specific areas to receive generous rewards.
2. Event Types: Events include three types: <Highlight>"Story", "Challenge", and "Competition".</>
3. Refresh Rules: When players enter "Sinful Tingen", all events meeting the conditions will be refreshed immediately. Among them, the registration time for <Highlight>"Competition" events is two minutes</>. The refresh interval for sudden events is based on the time the player enters the scene; <Highlight>"Challenge" events refresh approximately every 10 seconds</>, and if an event has ended, it will reappear.
4. Reward Rules: Reward rules vary by event type. <Highlight>"Story" events grant rewards upon success, "Challenge" events have tiered rewards, "Hard · Challenge" events do not have tiered rewards, and "Competition" events distribute rewards based on player ranking.</>
5. Reward Limit: There is no limit to the number of times a single player can receive rewards from events per week, but <Highlight>there is a weekly cap on Bounty Points.</>
6. Failure Conditions: If the objective (if any) is not completed within the event time limit, the event is considered failed.
7. Departure Judgment: If you move too far away from the event area before the event is completed, it will be judged as abandoning the event, and you will not be able to receive rewards.
8. Player Combat Power: Attribute balancing will be applied upon entering the "Sinful Tingen" plane. The "Story", "Hard · Challenge", and "Competition" modes within it are all attribute-balanced gameplay. <Highlight>"Fierce Battle · Bonnie" is affected by player combat power, with attribute balancing based on a gradient converted from the player's combat power.</>

亲爱的非凡者：
    愿您的非凡之路平稳顺利。
    自从您被命运召唤来到这个世界后，已经悄然过去了两日。在廷根的街巷之中，是哪里让您第一次驻足，感受到了这个世界的真实？在战斗中，是哪个瞬间让您心跳加速，成功"扮演"了您的序列身份？在剧情里，又是哪个选择或哪句台词，触动了您的心弦？
    无论您的答案为何，我们都将无比珍视。诚邀您再次通过信件中的隐秘通道，将您的见证与体悟传递给我们。您的每一处洞察，都将助我们雕琢出更真实的世界。
    感谢您为这世界带来的改变。祝愿您早日消化魔药，掌控非凡。
ref_en:
<M_Red>「Complete the questionnaire to receive 300 Bound Gold Pounds!」</>
<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="web=%s">Gray Fog Test Survey 2</>
Dear Beyonder: 
    May your Beyonder path be smooth and steady. 
    Since you were summoned by fate to this world, two days have passed quietly. In the streets and alleys of Tingen, where did you first stop and feel the reality of this world? In battle, which moment made your heart race and allowed you to successfully "act" as your Sequence identity? In the story, which choice or line touched your heartstrings? 
    No matter what your answer is, we will cherish it immensely. We sincerely invite you to pass your witness and insights to us again through the secret channel in the letter. Every insight of yours will help us carve out a more real world. 
    Thank you for the changes you have brought to this world. May you digest your potion and master your Beyonder powers soon.

ref_en: After using One-Click Aggregation, the Beyonder's Beyonder Materials, Aggregation Factors, and Bound Soules will be consumed. Aggregation will proceed in order: 1-stat with 1-stat materials, 2-stat with 2-stat materials, and 3-stat with 3-stat materials. The system will automatically retain products based on the rule: Fool stat priority, followed by other Mutation stats, and then rating priority. \nNote: Two Beyonder Materials with Mutation stats will not be aggregated. One-Click Aggregation will not occur if the number of remaining Beyonder Materials is low. Tradable Beyonder Materials will not be included in One-Click or Custom Aggregation. Beyonder Materials with Mutation stats will be included in One-Click Aggregation but not in Custom Aggregation.

source_cn:
%s:
      我听闻你与安西娅遭遇了一场苦战。不必过分担忧。在过去的岁月循环中，我已经明白失败与胜利——乃至生存与死亡——都不过是一时的、相对的：它只是你旅途中的一个普通坐标，用来验证你的成长。谨记面对安西娅的诀窍：<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302119">安西娅的记载</>
      对于一位总在路上的旅人来说，我知道让人停下脚步的常常并非挫折本身，而是失去了再次上路的勇气。所幸你并不胆怯于面对更多新冒险，我想下次，我听到的就会是更好的消息。对你这样年轻的非凡者而言，你已经做得很好。
      如果你需要的话，漫长的时光为我积淀下一些经验，也许对你有用。<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">点此查看</>
ref_en:
%s:
      I heard that you encountered a bitter battle with Anthea. Do not worry too much. In the cycles of time past, I have come to understand that failure and victory—and even life and death—are merely temporary and relative: they are just ordinary coordinates on your journey, used to verify your growth. Keep in mind the tips for facing Anthea: <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302119">Records of Anthea</>
      For a traveler who is always on the road, I know that what makes people stop is often not the setback itself, but the loss of courage to set off again. Fortunately, you are not timid about facing new adventures, and I think next time, the news I hear will be better. For a young Beyonder like you, you have already done very well. 
      If you need it, the long passage of time has accumulated some experience for me that might be useful to you. <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">Click here to view</>

I think we will soon be able to save up for Grandfather's medical expenses." \n"Dear Mom, I have met a doctor friend and witnessed some... special things. I have found a better job. Also, the money has been sent home. In the package, there is medicine for Grandfather, as well as new dresses for you and my sister. There is an extra gift for my sister; please tell her it is a congratulation for getting into university. Conston is a good place; when the holidays come, we can reunite there." \n"Dear Mom, the war has started! I think the capital should be the safest place. source_cn:
狒狒最初只是一只狒狒，每日望天、挠痒、抓虱子。
丰收时节，总有人类对着金黄的大树晃胳膊踢腿，摆出奇怪动作。
狒狒不关心，狒狒只关心人类留下的面包。
后来，在丰饶之树浸染下，狒狒成为了非凡狒狒，才明白那种行为叫做跳舞。
森林里红发绿裙的人类也会跳舞，她脚步轻盈，腰肢柔韧，会温柔地抚摸狒狒的卷毛。
狒狒开始模仿人类跳舞，并逐渐体会到其中乐趣。
它成了丰饶之树舞王，每天率领狒子狒孙摇摆身躯，邀请路过的人类共舞。
四季轮转，人类来了又往，狒狒还是狒狒，热情永不减退。
ref_en:
The baboon was initially just a baboon, looking at the sky, scratching, and catching lice every day. 
 During the harvest season, humans would always wave their arms and kick their legs at the golden tree, performing strange movements. 
 The baboon didn't care; the baboon only cared about the bread left by humans. 
 Later, under the influence of the Tree of Abundance, the baboon became a Beyonder baboon and finally understood that this behavior was called dancing. 
 The human with red hair and a green dress in the forest would also dance; she had light steps, a flexible waist, and would gently stroke the baboon's curly hair. 
 The baboon began to imitate the human's dance and gradually realized the fun in it. 
 It became the dance king of the Tree of Abundance, leading its baboon descendants to sway their bodies every day, inviting passing humans to dance together. 
 As the seasons turned, humans came and went, but the baboon was still a baboon, and its enthusiasm never faded.

“阁下，我们该怎么称呼您？”
　　阿尔杰微微点头，跟着庄重问道：
　　“阁下，我们该怎么称呼您？”
　　周明瑞听得愣了一下，放在青铜长桌上的手指轻轻敲动起来，脑海内霍然闪过了之前占卜的内容。
　　他往后一靠，收回右手，十指交叉着抵于下巴，微笑看着两人道：
　　“你们可以称呼我……”
　　说到这里，他顿了顿，语气轻和而平淡地开口：
　　“愚者。”

　　——第一卷《小丑》第六章 非凡者
ref_en:
"Your Excellency, how should we address you?" 
 Alger nodded slightly and followed up solemnly: 
 "Your Excellency, how should we address you?" 
 Zhou Mingrui was stunned for a moment, his fingers tapping gently on the bronze long table, and the content of his previous divination flashed through his mind. 
 He leaned back, withdrew his right hand, clasped his fingers together against his chin, and looked at the two of them with a smile: 
 "You may address me as..." 
 Having said this, he paused, and spoke in a gentle and calm tone: 
 "The Fool." 
 
 —Volume 1 "Clown", Chapter 6: Beyonder

source_cn:
这一年的最后一天，森林遭遇了百年未遇的暴雪，猫头鹰长老召集起了一场紧急会议。

　　 “北边山洞上方的积雪发生了崩塌，那里面还住着冬眠的蝙蝠一家，我们不能放着它们不管。”

　　所有的动物都沉默了，它们基本不和蝙蝠来往，只有邓恩在去年春天去过那个洞穴，但它早就忘记里面什么样了。

　　“我们去吧！”戴莉跳到了鹿角顶端，“就算你在里面迷失了方向，我的歌声也能把我们带到正确的道路上。”

　　它们就这样进入了洞穴，里面结构错综复杂，邓恩和戴莉费了不少力气才找到受伤的蝙蝠一家。就在它们准备离开洞穴的时候，外面狂风大作，无数雪花被风裹挟而来，挡住了所有的光。邓恩又尝试了几个方向，比找不到出口更令人绝望的是蝙蝠一家越来越微弱的呼吸。

　　戴莉飞到了它耳边开始歌唱，金色的旋律指引抚平了邓恩有些焦躁的心情，他沿着音符亮起的方向走去。十米，五十米，一百米……眼前仍然没有出现洞口的光亮，戴莉意识到前往出口的代价可能比想象中更多。

　　没有犹豫。

　　它飞得更高了，飞到邓恩根本看不清的地方，歌唱到背上的羽毛所剩无几，她开始下坠。

　　眼前还是没有出现光亮。
ref_en:
On the last day of this year, the forest encountered a blizzard unseen in a hundred years, and the owl elder convened an emergency meeting.

	 "The snow above the cave in the north has collapsed, and a family of hibernating bats still lives inside. We cannot just leave them alone."

	All the animals were silent; they basically didn't associate with bats. Only Dunn had been to that cave last spring, but he had long forgotten what it looked like inside.

	"Let's go!" Daly jumped to the top of the antlers, "Even if you lose your way inside, my singing can lead us to the right path."

	They entered the cave just like that. The structure inside was intricate, and it took Dunn and Daly quite a bit of effort to find the injured bat family. Just as they were preparing to leave the cave, a violent storm raged outside, and countless snowflakes were carried by the wind, blocking all light. Dunn tried a few more directions, and what was more desperate than not finding the exit was the increasingly weak breathing of the bat family.

	Daly flew to his ear and began to sing. The golden melody guided and smoothed out Dunn's somewhat restless mood, and he walked along the direction where the notes lit up. Ten meters, fifty meters, one hundred meters... there was still no light from the cave entrance in sight. Daly realized that the cost of reaching the exit might be more than imagined.

	Without hesitation.

	It flew higher, flying to a place where Dunn couldn't see clearly at all, singing until there were few feathers left on its back, and she began to fall.

	There was still no light in sight.

source_cn: 再晚点通知我们维修工的话，恐怕要出命案。
ref_en: If we don't notify the maintenance workers any later, I'm afraid there will be a fatality.

source_cn: 别灰心啊，你的曲子赶跑了乌鸦，也帮情侣解决了矛盾。普通的婚礼乐师能做到这些吗？
ref_en: Don't be discouraged. Your music chased away the crows and helped the couple resolve their conflict. Can an ordinary wedding musician do that?

source_cn: 和之前在混乱之地看到的巨大雕像很相似……拿着过去祭拜一下，说不定会有什么事发生。
ref_en: It looks very similar to the giant statue I saw in the Land of Chaos earlier... Maybe if I take it there to pay my respects, something might happen.

source_cn: 哈哈哈哈！倒霉蛋，倒霉蛋，全世界都是倒霉蛋！
ref_en: Hahahaha! Loser, loser, the whole world is full of losers!

source_cn: 地上怎么有奇怪的影子，用光点亮试试
ref_en: Why is there a strange shadow on the ground? Try lighting it up.
Ma'am, do you need any help?

source_cn: 好像身体里的力量忽然消失，但又回来了？
ref_en: Does it seem like the power in my body suddenly disappeared, but then came back?
Alright, I'll pick a few more.

ref_en: If that is truly the reason, {{Mr.|Ms.}}, could I ask you to help look after this old gentleman?

source_cn: 完成前置任务<H>美梦成真上</>
ref_en: Complete the prerequisite quest <H>Dreams Come True (Part 1)</>

source_cn: 年轻人，别这么想。生活虽然苦，但总得有点盼头。
ref_en: Young man, don't think like that. Life is bitter, but there's always something to look forward to.

source_cn: 当前场景没有存活的守卫者，请等待守卫者刷新。
ref_en: There are no surviving Guardians in the current scene; please wait for the Guardians to refresh.

I divined that you were in danger!

source_cn: 我无法停下追逐未知的脚步
ref_en: I cannot stop my pursuit of the unknown.

source_cn: 我本来就是……守护这里的……
ref_en: I was originally... the one guarding this place...
I'll give you a feel for it!

source_cn: 所以我建议你们不要进去，毕竟这么做有不小的风险。
ref_en: So I suggest you do not go in; after all, doing so carries significant risks.

ref_en: Is that so? I'd like to see what the famous detective can do to me.

source_cn: 是海莉夫人那番话让我下决心的。她说得对，只要站起来，剑就留在地上了。
ref_en: It was Madam Haley's words that made me make up my mind. She was right, as long as you stand up, the swords stay on the ground.

本店上新了茉莉拿铁，要试试吗？
ref_en: Our shop has a new jasmine latte, would you like to try it?

ref_en: Nothing, I previously met a child who claimed to be the Minister of Finance, he asked me for some money, is he also your subject?
No, I'll go take a look

source_cn: 由于长时间未能匹配到合适的队伍，已自动取消当前快速匹配
ref_en: Due to failing to find a suitable team for a long time, the current quick match has been automatically canceled.

source_cn: 真好，我也想认识认识这些朋友！
ref_en: That's great, I also want to meet these friends!
So happy to receive a gift...

source_cn: 算了，我不想在几个便士上浪费生命！
ref_en: Forget it, I don't want to waste my life over a few pennies!

source_cn: 罗塞尔Boss-知识抽取-法术书
背誓之战\n因弗萨克帝国和鲁恩王国为争夺苏尼亚海的控制权而爆发。
ref_en: War of the Oath-Breakers \n Broke out between the Feysac Empire and the Loen Kingdom over control of the Sonia Sea.

source_cn: 莫妮卡一定会为这个礼物而感到惊喜的！
ref_en: Monica will definitely be surprised by this gift!

source_cn: 衣帽被好好挂起，远方的行人就这样回到安稳的居所。
ref_en: Clothes and hats are hung up properly; thus, the traveler from afar returns to a stable home.

source_cn: 被遗忘者已然返航，他的桅杆和钩索便是你们的绞刑架！
ref_en: The forgotten one has returned, and his masts and hooks are your gallows!

source_cn: 见到他之前，您还得自己行动一段时间，带着伤会不方便的。如果先治好，之后就不会有妨碍了。
ref_en: Before you see him, you will have to act on your own for a while; it will be inconvenient with your injuries. If you get them treated first, there won't be any obstacles later.
Feel free to take a look at any of these flowers.

source_cn: 这是我们仅有的找到睡莲仙女的线索，说什么都不能放弃！
ref_en: This is our only clue to finding the Water Lily Fairy; we cannot give up no matter what!

source_cn: 这需要它吃掉……相当于十倍自身体重的食物？这不可能！
ref_en: That would require it to eat... food equivalent to ten times its own body weight? That's impossible!

source_cn: 难以想象是一个刚入职的新人。
ref_en: Hard to imagine this is a newcomer who just joined.

source_cn: 不知怎么，总感觉有些眼熟……您家里有兄弟吗？
ref_en: I don't know why, but you look familiar... do you have any brothers?

source_cn: 不过，鲁莽泄恨的人，往往只会自己喝下苦酒。
ref_en: However, those who vent their hatred recklessly often only end up drinking bitter wine themselves.

source_cn: 云朵被你点燃，盛放作玫瑰。
ref_en: The clouds are ignited by you, blooming into roses.

source_cn: 代价也挺大，前面好几个序列完全不能打，到序列六都是学者型。
ref_en: The price was also quite high; the first few sequences were completely unable to fight, and up to Sequence 6, they were all scholar-types.

source_cn: 以及，指导我们的新鲜血液。
ref_en: And to guide our fresh blood.

source_cn: 你知道十六年前轰动了整个廷根市的那个连环杀手吗？
ref_en: Do you know about the serial killer who shocked the entire city of Tingen sixteen years ago?

source_cn: 你获得了"战士"途径序列6"黎明骑士"的部分剑术感悟，攻击提高45%。你的每一次挥击都如同破晓的晨曦般锐利，能撕裂黑暗的帷幕。
ref_en: You have gained some sword mastery insights from the Warrior pathway, Sequence 6, Dawn Knight; Attack increased by 45%. Every swing of yours is as sharp as the breaking dawn, capable of tearing through the veil of darkness.

ref_en: Use to obtain <Highlight>Song of Iron and Blood Hand Accessory</>

source_cn: 其实作为剧作家，在创作时陷入情绪波动是很正常的，但是像老师这样严重的癔症，真是从未听说过。
ref_en: Actually, as a playwright, it's normal to experience emotional fluctuations while creating, but I've never heard of such severe hysteria as the teacher's.

source_cn: 别输给那帮人！你们是最棒的绿色闪电！
ref_en: Don't lose to those guys! You are the best Green Lightning!

source_cn: 到你出场了，听话的好心人。
ref_en: It's your turn to shine, obedient kind-hearted person.

source_cn: 剩余物产转换商会票券
ref_en: Convert remaining products into Chamber tickets

source_cn: 可您拥有月光般的皮肤、宝石似的红瞳……
ref_en: But you have skin like moonlight, red eyes like gemstones...

source_cn: 合并俱乐部操作目标不能是自己俱乐部
ref_en: Cannot merge with your own club.

source_cn: 呼吸和心跳是活着的象征，也许有别的东西能成为一个人的“呼吸”和“心跳”……
ref_en: Breathing and a heartbeat are symbols of being alive; perhaps there are other things that can become a person's "breath" and "heartbeat"...

source_cn: 咳咳……拉里，实话说，你加入代罚者之前头顶也并不茂盛，或许这并不是非凡因素导致的。
ref_en: Ahem... Larry, to be honest, your head wasn't very lush before you joined the Mandated Punishers. Perhaps this isn't caused by Beyonder factors.

source_cn: 唉，横财什么时候能轮到我发啊。
ref_en: Sigh, when will it be my turn to strike it rich?

source_cn: 喝下那杯茶的人，会得到与茶会主人共饮的机会。
ref_en: Whoever drinks that cup will get the chance to have a drink with the host of the tea party.

source_cn:
嘘，关于它的故事，你知道得不必太多。
别急着摩挲它的表面，别急着说出你的愿望！
这个故事从第一纪就已经开始。“0-05”的代号能证明它的危险，却无法将它的身份说清。
那里封存着来自星空的低语。那是阴险狡诈的“灯神”，在等着扭曲这场交易。
一、二……
不要数到三。
ref_en:
Shh, you don't need to know too much about its story. 
 Don't be in a hurry to stroke its surface, don't be in a hurry to state your wish! 
 This story began as early as the First Epoch. The codename "0-05" can prove its danger, but it cannot explain its identity. 
 It seals whispers from the stars. That is the insidious and cunning "God of Knowledge and Wisdom," waiting to distort this transaction. 
 One, two... 
 Do not count to three.

source_cn: 大地的恩赐：筛10个血量最少的友方
ref_en: Gift of the Earth: Filter 10 allies with lowest HP

source_cn: 女神啊，我不会以后都吃不上午餐吧？
ref_en: Goddess, I won't be unable to eat lunch from now on, will I?

source_cn: 如果您愿意补偿三天工钱 我们会感激您的慷慨
ref_en: If you are willing to compensate them with three days' wages, we would be grateful for your generosity.

source_cn: 妈妈说攒够钱就送我去学画画，希望客人们多买点……
ref_en: Mom said she'd send me to learn painting once she saves enough money. I hope the customers buy more...
Watching the stall is quite boring...

年轻人，你想加入祷告的队伍吗？
ref_en: Young person, would you like to join the prayer group?

ref_en: Look, aren't the locals all buying things busily?
Feel the Power of Some Mysticism...

source_cn: 我把愿望写下来，就像在跟她说话一样。
ref_en: I write down my wishes, and it's like I'm talking to her.

source_cn: 我的丈夫霍克斯男爵离奇死亡，我认为这件事情另有内情，所以才请您过来。
ref_en: My husband, Baron Hawkes, died mysteriously. I believe there is more to this matter, which is why I invited you here.

source_cn: 我知道你不是警察，但我信得过你。这张通行证可以让你直接进去。
ref_en: I know you are not a policeman, but I trust you. This pass will allow you to enter directly.

ref_en: Can be used after reaching Acting Level 70. Increases all five attributes by 5 points for 1800 seconds (a maximum of two attribute potions can be active simultaneously).

ref_en: Betting · Food Shop effective, obtain 100% of own [Bronze Candlestick]

ref_en: It moved away or went out of business, which version do you want to hear?

source_cn: 收尸人途径 | 序列2“死亡执政官”
敌人攻击你时会随机染上麻痹、虚弱等毒素，叠满即恶化；你死去时还会残留一片毒池。作为持有者，毒素也不可避免地挥发到你自己身上。
ref_en: When enemies attack you, they will randomly be infected with toxins like Paralysis and Weakness; when stacked, it worsens. You will also leave a pool of venom when you die. As the holder, the toxins inevitably evaporate onto yourself as well.

source_cn: 是啊。这些东西放在黑荆棘的话，会让人感觉那些热闹还在。
ref_en: Yes. If these things are kept in Blackthorn, it makes people feel like that liveliness is still there.

Look, the chain is loose here...

ref_en: The Rock Knight releases all energy for a Critical Hit; quickly hide behind the ice pillar!

<Highlight>非凡聚合</>：可以将两个非凡物质聚合成一个新的非凡物质。
<Highlight>词条继承</>：非凡聚合时，聚合产物词条会<Highlight>全部</>从<Highlight>放入的非凡物质</>的词条中随机选取。
<Highlight>词条异变</>：放入聚合的非凡物质词条总数大于等于6时，聚合后有极小概率出现异变，生成异变词条，放入聚合的非凡物质词条总数量与类型不同时，可以出现的异变词条不同。
<Highlight>词条升级</>：放入聚合的非凡物质词条总数大于等于6时，聚合后有概率触发词条升级，部分词条的属性值提升。
<Highlight>高级聚合</>：当前持有的4词条及以上攻击非凡物质与防御非凡物质均达到2个时，解锁4词条攻击非凡物质放入聚合；当前持有的5词条攻击非凡物质与防御非凡物质均达到2个时，解锁5词条非凡物质放入聚合。
<Highlight>聚合熟练度</>：进行非凡物质聚合时会提升<Highlight>聚合熟练度</>，聚合熟练度赛季重置，达到一定值后可以获得奖励。
ref_en:
<Highlight>Beyonder Aggregation</>: You can aggregate two Beyonder materials into a new Beyonder material.
<Highlight>Trait Inheritance</>: During Beyonder Aggregation, the traits of the resulting product will be <Highlight>all</> randomly selected from the traits of the <Highlight>input Beyonder materials</>.
<Highlight>Trait Mutation</>: When the total number of traits of the input Beyonder materials is 6 or more, there is a very small chance of mutation after aggregation, generating a mutated trait. Different mutated traits can appear depending on the total number and types of traits in the input Beyonder materials.
<Highlight>Trait Upgrade</>: When the total number of traits of the input Beyonder materials is 6 or more, there is a chance to trigger a trait upgrade after aggregation, increasing the attribute values of some traits.
<Highlight>Advanced Aggregation</>: When you currently possess 2 attack Beyonder materials with 4+ traits and 2 defense Beyonder materials with 4+ traits, you unlock the ability to use 4-trait Beyonder materials in aggregation; when you possess 2 attack Beyonder materials with 5 traits and 2 defense Beyonder materials with 5 traits, you unlock the ability to use 5-trait Beyonder materials in aggregation.
<Highlight>Aggregation Proficiency</>: Performing Beyonder material aggregation will increase <Highlight>Aggregation Proficiency</>. Aggregation Proficiency resets each season, and you can obtain rewards upon reaching certain values.

source_cn:
<InvHighlight>1号子弹</>是真的。

欲念使者大幅降低了<InvHighlight>真弹的比例</>，使第一次选择命中真弹的概率变得<InvHighlight>微乎其微</>。

当一颗假弹被排除后，剩余选项中出现真弹的概率随之上升。因此，<InvHighlight>更换选择</>更为有利。

概率只能揭示更有利的选择，并不能决定最终结果。若实际结果与判断不符，也只是<InvHighlight>运气造成的偶然</>。
ref_en:
<InvHighlight>Bullet No. 1</> is real. 

The Messenger of Desire significantly reduced the <InvHighlight>proportion of real bullets</>, making the probability of hitting a real bullet on the first choice <InvHighlight>negligible</>. 

When a fake bullet is excluded, the probability of a real bullet appearing among the remaining options rises. Therefore, <InvHighlight>changing your choice</> is more advantageous. 

Probability can only reveal the more advantageous choice; it cannot determine the final result. If the actual result does not match the judgment, it is merely <InvHighlight>an accident caused by luck</>.

对前方扇形区域内的敌方进行三段式攻击，每段造成*d点物理伤害并<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="2">打断</>敌方怪物，第三段会附加一层<HighLight>愚弄标记</>并以*d**的基础概率将敌方<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="2">击退</>，附加*f秒mul(*d**,*d)<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="20">减疗</>，同时自身获得一张<HighLight>命运黄牌</>。

<FaintYellow>愚弄标记</>：叠加3层后引爆并移除愚弄标记，受到施加者造成的mul(*d,3)点物理伤害。
ref_en:
Performs a three-stage attack on enemies in a frontal fan-shaped area, with each stage dealing *d physical damage and <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="2">interrupting</> enemy monsters. The third stage applies one stack of <HighLight>Fooling Mark</> and has a base probability of *d** to <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="2">knock back</> the enemy, applying a *f-second mul(*d**,*d) <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="20">Healing Reduction</> effect, while you gain one <HighLight>Fate Yellow Card</>. 

<FaintYellow>Fate Yellow Card</>/<FaintYellow>Spirituality Blue Card</>: When you obtain three <HighLight>Fate Yellow Cards</>/<HighLight>Spirituality Blue Cards</>, consume all cards to switch the <HighLight>Finisher Skill Shuffle Cards</> to <HighLight>Fooling of Fate</>/<HighLight>Spirituality Burst</>. 
<FaintYellow>Fooling Mark</>: Upon stacking 3 times, it detonates and is removed, dealing mul(*d,3) physical damage to the target from the caster.

<Assistant_Title1>Obtain Marionette</>
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Instructions: </>
The Sealed Artifact "Utopia Theater"<Assistant_Property1> bestowed by Mr. Fool </> can help Beyonders obtain and control marionettes. 
1. Through <Assistant_System>Menu - Marionette - Obtain Marionette</>, you can enter the <Assistant_Property1>Utopia Theater</> to draw <Assistant_Property2>Marionettes</> and unlock corresponding Marionette Skills. 
2. The Utopia Theater stage <Assistant_Property1>refreshes</> <Assistant_Red>3</> marionettes for selection each time. If only <Assistant_Red>Purple</> quality marionettes remain on the stage after a draw, the stage will automatically refresh. 
Prologue Draw: Consume <Assistant_Property1>Golden Thread</>*3 to randomly obtain 1 of the 3 marionettes on stage. 
Interlude Draw: Consume <Assistant_Property1>Golden Thread</>*6 to randomly obtain 1 of the 2 remaining marionettes on stage. 
Curtain Call Draw: Consume <Assistant_Property1>Golden Thread</>*12 to guarantee obtaining the 1 remaining marionette on stage. 
3. After a Prologue Draw, you can also actively <Assistant_Property1>Give Up</> on the remaining marionettes to refresh. 
4. Perform <Assistant_Property1>Marionette Wish</> and select a specific marionette to increase the probability of that marionette appearing. 
5. Duplicate marionettes obtained will be converted into Marionette Fragments, which can be used for <Assistant_Property1>Marionette Cultivation</> to improve character attributes and enhance Marionette Skills. 
6. After Marionette Cultivation reaches the limit, excess <Assistant_Property1>Marionette Fragments</> will be converted into <Assistant_Property1>Marionette Clockwork</>, which can be exchanged for other items in the <Assistant_Property1>Marionette Shop</>. 
<Assistant_Title3>Recommended Searches: </>{SendAnswer:[秘偶培养]|537}, {SendAnswer:[人偶发条]|543}, {SendAnswer:[秘偶商店]|545}

source_cn:
老尼尔，黑荆棘资历最深的老前辈之一。他会教你冥想、灵视，还会教你在报销单上如何“合理”填数字。但他欠账三十镑时，也能对捡来的三百镑钱包分文不动。
“为所欲为，但勿伤害”，是他恪守一生的格言。
他曾是正式值夜者，但离晋升始终差了那么一步。年纪渐长，教会让他转做“看守者”或回家休养，他拒绝了。他只愿留在黑荆棘，守着那些泛黄的典籍，为大家点亮一盏灯。
在平常幽默风趣的相处中，没人知道，老尼尔一直在节省资金，试图用禁忌的“生命炼成”仪式复活亡妻。他在需要鲜血材料的配方旁写道：“可以考虑抽取我的。”——他宁愿用自己的血，也不愿伤害任何人。
直到隐匿贤者的低语吞没他，队友亲手送别他……当值夜者们翻开老尼尔的日记，看见最后一页写着：“如果不能拯救她，那就去陪伴她。”时，他们终于明白了老尼尔最后的坚守。
他想用余生为年轻人照亮一小段路，然后用生命，践行一句无人知晓的誓言。
ref_en:
Old Neil, one of the most senior veterans of the Blackthorn Security Company. He would teach you meditation, spirit vision, and how to "reasonably" fill in numbers on reimbursement forms. Yet, when he owed thirty pounds, he could remain unmoved by a wallet containing three hundred pounds he had found.
"Do what thou wilt, but harm none" was the motto he upheld his entire life.
He was once a formal Nighthawk, but he was always just one step away from advancement. As he grew older, the Church suggested he become a "Gatekeeper" or retire home, but he refused. He only wished to remain at Blackthorn, guarding those yellowed classics and lighting a lamp for everyone.
Amidst the usual humor and lighthearted interactions, no one knew that Old Neil had been saving money, attempting to resurrect his late wife using the forbidden "Life Creation" ritual. Beside the formula requiring blood materials, he wrote: "Consider drawing mine."—he would rather use his own blood than harm anyone.
Until the whispers of the Hidden Sage engulfed him, and his teammates had to personally bid him farewell... When the Nighthawks opened Old Neil's diary and saw the last page written: "If I cannot save her, then I shall accompany her," they finally understood Old Neil's final persistence.
He wanted to light up a short path for the young ones with the rest of his life, and then, with his life, fulfill a vow no one knew.

<Highlight>【规则说明】</>

<Title>逃离监狱</>
1.你被困在危机四伏的监狱之中，突破重重机关，找到逃生点。
2.超过其他狱友，获取更多的积分，赢取丰厚奖励。
3.10分钟时间耗尽仍未完成逃脱，逃离失败。
<Title>躲避光照</>
1.监狱中会有巡逻光照不断扫过场地，被发现后会被锁链束缚。
2.不要掉进毒液池中，也要躲避毒液花的攻击。
<Title>符文谜题</>
1.逃生出口需要破解符文屏障才能打开，需要在地面寻找散落的符文。
2.累计找到16个符文后，屏障将被破除。
ref_en:
<Highlight>【Rules】</>

<Title>Escape from Prison</>
1. You are trapped in a dangerous prison; break through various mechanisms to find the escape point. 
2. Surpass other inmates to earn more points and win generous rewards. 
3. If the escape is not completed within 10 minutes, the escape fails. 
<Title>Avoid the Light</>
1. Patrol lights in the prison will constantly scan the area; being discovered will result in being bound by chains. 
2. Do not fall into the venom pools, and avoid attacks from venom flowers. 
<Title>Rune Puzzle</>
1. The escape exit requires breaking the rune barrier, which requires finding scattered runes on the ground. 
2. After finding a total of 16 runes, the barrier will be broken.

The first and second place in each Four-Way League match enter the winner's bracket, and the third and fourth place enter the loser's bracket; after the second match, the 1st to 8th place for the round are determined based on the match results. 
 Warzone screening points are composed of the accumulation of <Highlight> single-match ranking points </> and <Highlight> final round ranking points </>: 
 <Highlight> Single-match ranking points: </> 1st place 30 points, 2nd place 15 points, 3rd place 10 points, 4th place 5 points. 
 <Highlight> First round final ranking points: </> 1st place 60 points, 2nd place 50 points, 3rd place 45 points, 4th place 40 points, 5th to 8th place 10 points each. 
 <Highlight> Second round final ranking points: </> 1st place 200 points, 2nd place 100 points, 3rd place 70 points, 4th place 50 points, 5th to 8th place 15 points each. 
 <Highlight> Tie-breaking rules: </> Warzone screening rankings are prioritized by <Highlight> total warzone screening points </> from high to low. When total points are the same: After the first or second round of the league, sort according to the club's <Highlight> final ranking </> in this round, with higher rankings taking precedence; after the first match of each round of the Four-Way League, the final ranking for this round has not yet been generated, so clubs with the same points are not distinguished by ranking, and the current display order does not represent the final ranking of this round.

不用意外！我预先知道你会到这里，留下了这封信，其他人看不到。
　　我赶稿实在抽不开身，麻烦帮我把这本新书带给塔罗会的“月亮”先生。书钱我已经付过了！
　　“月亮”目前以大地母神教会执事的身份，在金秋湖调查“丰饶污染”事件。你们正好可以借此认识一下。
　　对了，“月亮”先生是血族，请一定不要叫他“吸血鬼”——那很不礼貌！
　　附一张他自己很满意的画像，方便你辨认。
（字迹越来越潦草……似乎没时间写更多了。）
ref_en:
Don't be surprised! I knew in advance that you would come here and left this letter, others can't see it.
　　I'm too busy with my manuscript to get away, so please help me bring this new book to Mr. Moon of the Tarot Club. I have already paid for the book!
　　"Moon" is currently investigating the "Abundance Corruption" incident at Golden Autumn Lake as a deacon of the Earth Mother Church. You can just happen to get to know each other.
　　By the way, Mr. Moon is a Sanguine, please don't call him a "vampire"—that's very rude!
　　Attached is a portrait he is very satisfied with, for your identification.
(The handwriting is getting more and more illegible... seems like there is no time to write more.)

source_cn:
%s，好久不见：
      我听说了你最近与厄水巨龟艰辛的交战。辛苦了，你一直都很努力。我和苏茜搜集了一些有关厄水巨龟的情报，希望能有所帮助：<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302109">厄水巨龟的记载</>
      你所承受的命运写满了未知与危险，连我们也无法勘破你身上的迷雾和谜团。未来或许还有更多的险境、更大的危机在等待着我们。我们都需要变得更强，才能保护好自己和珍视的事物。但当你疲惫的时候，欢迎随时来命运咖啡厅坐坐，我这里有不错的红茶和糕点，或许你会喜欢。闲暇的时候，可以来陪我和苏茜聊聊天，让心态平和下来，一切都会好起来的。
      不用担心，我和其他人都会尽力帮助你，随信附上一些提升实力的建议。<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">点此查看</>
ref_en:
%s, long time no see: 
      I heard about your recent arduous battle with the Misfortune Water Giant Turtle. You've worked hard; you have always been very diligent. Susie and I have gathered some intelligence regarding the Misfortune Water Giant Turtle, and I hope it proves helpful: <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302109">Records of the Misfortune Water Giant Turtle</>
      The fate you bear is filled with unknowns and dangers; even we cannot pierce through the mist and mysteries surrounding you. Perhaps more perilous situations and greater crises await us in the future. We all need to become stronger to protect ourselves and the things we cherish. But when you are exhausted, you are always welcome to come to the Fate Café for a seat. I have some excellent black tea and pastries here that you might enjoy. In your spare time, feel free to come chat with Susie and me to calm your mind; everything will be alright. 
      Do not worry; I and the others will do our best to help you. Attached to this letter are some suggestions for improving your strength. <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">Click here to view</>

<Assistant_Title1>Connections</>
<Assistant_Title2>Instructions:</>
With the help of the Sealed Artifact <Assistant_Property1>Corridor of History</>, you can search for figures scattered throughout history within the gaps of time, get to know them, and borrow power from the past.
Getting to know them multiple times increases your understanding of the target and grants you access to more authentic and powerful abilities.
1. You can obtain <Assistant_Property1>Connections</> by <Assistant_Property2>making acquaintances</>, which unlocks corresponding skills.
2. Duplicate Connections can be used to upgrade your Connection level, thereby enhancing the effects of the corresponding skills.
3. Making more acquaintances increases your understanding of them, improves your {SendAnswer:关系|551}Historical Research<Assistant_Property2> level, and grants certain attribute bonuses.</>
How to make acquaintances:<Assistant_Title2></>Click 
Menu - Connections - Make Acquaintances<Assistant_System> to enter the </>interface, then click 'Make Acquaintance 1 time/5 times' to proceed.{SendAnswer:结交人脉|554}
Cost:<Assistant_Title2></>Each attempt requires one 
Historical Beacon{SendAnswer:历史明灯|556}.
<Assistant_Title2>Rules:</>
1. In every 5 attempts, you are guaranteed to obtain at least one Epic-grade Connection or higher.
2. If you do not obtain a Legendary Connection after 24 consecutive attempts, the probability will gradually increase. You are guaranteed to obtain a Legendary Connection every 40 attempts. Once a Legendary Connection is obtained, the counter resets and the probability returns to the base rate.
3. The pity counters for permanent and limited-time events are accumulated separately and do not affect each other.
4. For permanent events, you can set a wish for a specific Connection to increase the probability of obtaining it.
5. When you obtain a duplicate Connection, you will receive additional {SendAnswer:投影片段|557}projection fragments. If that Connection has already reached its maximum level or you have enough materials to reach the maximum, the number of fragments received will increase. Fragments can be used in the Connections Shop to exchange for Historical Beacons or specific Connections.
<Assistant_Title3>Recommended Searches:</>{SendAnswer:[关系]|551}, {SendAnswer:[结交人脉]|554}, {SendAnswer:[人脉许愿]|555}

<Assistant_Title1>非凡物质</>
<Assistant_Title2>玩法说明：</>
1、带有非凡力量的物质，可以填充入<Assistant_Property1>封印物</>来稳定历史投影，并解锁更多额外的<Assistant_Property2>非凡共鸣</>效果。
2、非凡特性的力量量化为词条，不同非凡物质由于构成的非凡特性序列与数量不同，词条数量、类型与强度会有不同。最少有1条词条，最多可以达到6条词条，超过6条词条的非凡物质暂时未被发现。
3、非凡物质的随机词条受高位格力量影响或污染，可能会出现异变，<Assistant_Property2>异变词条</>相对于普通词条，会带来更为强大的效果。异变词条在单个非凡物质上最多出现1条。
<Assistant_Title3>推荐搜索：</>{SendAnswer:[封印物]|1265}，{SendAnswer:[获取非凡物质]|1269}，{SendAnswer:[非凡物质聚合]|1270}
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>Beyonder Material</>
<Assistant_Title2> Gameplay Instructions: </>
1. Materials containing Beyonder power can be filled into <Assistant_Property1>Sealed Artifacts</> to stabilize historical projections and unlock more additional <Assistant_Property2>Beyonder Resonance</> effects.
2. The power of Beyonder characteristics is quantified into entries. Due to the different Beyonder characteristic sequences and quantities that compose them, Beyonder materials vary in the number, type, and strength of their entries. There is at least 1 entry, and up to 6 entries; Beyonder materials with more than 6 entries have not yet been discovered.
3. The random entries of Beyonder materials are influenced or corrupted by high-level powers, which may lead to mutations. <Assistant_Property2>Mutated entries</> bring more powerful effects compared to ordinary entries. A single Beyonder material can have at most 1 mutated entry.
<Assistant_Title3> Recommended Searches: </>{SendAnswer:[Sealed Artifact]|1265}, {SendAnswer:[Obtaining Beyonder Materials]|1269}, {SendAnswer:[Beyonder Material Aggregation]|1270}

source_cn:
廷根晨报，入室抢劫杀人案

　　……据警察部门透露，韦尔奇先生的家里场面惨不忍睹，并且丢失了所有的黄金、珠宝和钞票，以及一切值钱的、便于拿走的物品，甚至连铜便士都没有剩下。有理由相信，这是一伙残忍凶恶的歹徒，他们会毫不犹豫杀掉看见了他们长相的无辜者，比如韦尔奇先生，比如娜娅女士。

　　这是对王国法律的践踏！这是对公共安全的挑衅！没有人希望遭遇类似的事情！当然，一个好消息是，警察部门已经锁定了凶手，抓到了主犯，我们将尽快给出后续报道。

　　记者：约翰·勃朗宁
ref_en:
Tingen Morning Post, Home Invasion and Murder Case 
 
 ... According to the police department, the scene at Mr. Welch's home was horrific. All the gold, jewelry, and banknotes were missing, as well as everything valuable and easy to carry, not even a single copper penny was left. There is reason to believe that this is a group of cruel and vicious criminals who would not hesitate to kill innocent people who saw their faces, such as Mr. Welch and Ms. Naya. 
 
 This is a trampling of the kingdom's laws! This is a provocation to public safety! No one wishes to encounter such things! Of course, one piece of good news is that the police department has identified the culprits and caught the main perpetrator. We will provide follow-up reports as soon as possible. 
 
 Reporter: John Browning

灯神并非慷慨无私，当愿望达成后，他也会拿走相应的代价：
<Red>年华骤逝</>：青春永驻结束时，扣除*f**剩余生命值。
<Red>情义透支</>：同心之援返还冷却的普通技能，再度进入冷却时，额外触发3秒冷却时间。
<Red>强弩之末</>：背水一击结束后的30秒内，buffdisc(*id)
<Red>排异</>：战斗中每隔30秒，随机两条非凡物质词条属性失效，持续15秒。
ref_en:
The Genie is not generous or selfless; once a wish is fulfilled, he will also take a corresponding price: 
<Red>Fleeting Youth</>: When Eternal Youth ends, deduct *f** of your remaining Health. 
<Red>Overdrawn Bonds</>: When a basic skill whose Cooldown was refunded by Concentric Aid enters Cooldown again, it triggers an additional 3-second Cooldown. 
<Red>End of the Tether</>: Within 30 seconds after Last Stand ends, buffdisc(*id). 
<Red>Rejection</>: Every 30 seconds during combat, two random Beyonder material attributes become ineffective for 15 seconds.

对前方扇形区域内的敌方进行三段式攻击，每段造成*d点物理伤害并<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="2">打断</>敌方怪物，第一段释放后自身6秒内buffdisc(*id)，第三段会附加一层<HighLight>愚弄标记</>并以*d**的基础概率将敌方<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="2">击退</>，附加*f秒mul(*d**,*d)<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="20">减疗</>，同时自身获得一张<HighLight>命运黄牌</>。

<FaintYellow>命运黄牌</>/<FaintYellow>灵性蓝牌</>：获得三张<HighLight>命运黄牌</>/<HighLight>灵性蓝牌</>时消耗所有卡牌，使<HighLight>终结技能洗牌</>切换至<HighLight>命运愚弄</>/<HighLight>灵性爆发</>。
<FaintYellow>愚弄标记</>：叠加3层后引爆并移除愚弄标记，受到施加者造成的mul(*d,3)点物理伤害。
ref_en:
Performs a three-stage attack on enemies in a frontal fan-shaped area, with each stage dealing *d physical damage and <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="2">interrupting</> enemy monsters. After the first stage is released, you gain buffdisc(*id) for 6 seconds. The third stage applies one stack of <HighLight>Fooling Mark</> and has a base probability of *d** to <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="2">knock back</> the enemy, applying a *f-second mul(*d**,*d) <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="20">Healing Reduction</> effect, while you gain one <HighLight>Fate Yellow Card</>. 

<FaintYellow>Fate Yellow Card</>/<FaintYellow>Spirituality Blue Card</>: When you obtain three <HighLight>Fate Yellow Cards</>/<HighLight>Spirituality Blue Cards</>, consume all cards to switch the <HighLight>Finisher Skill Shuffle Cards</> to <HighLight>Fooling of Fate</>/<HighLight>Spirituality Burst</>. 
<FaintYellow>Fooling Mark</>: Upon stacking 3 times, it detonates and is removed, dealing mul(*d,3) physical damage to the target from the caster.
